lead: `bun nv try` cannot run a case that carries a second `--FILE <name>--` section, and what it prints reads as if the case itself were broken.
body: It hands everything after `--FILE--` to the compiler, so a `--FILE nvs.toml--` capability grant arrives as Novis source and answers with parse errors on `[capabilities.net]`. `target/debug/nvs.exe test <case.nvst>` runs one case the way the suite does and honours the extra sections; for a single-file case `bun nv try` is still the cheap way to capture an `--EXPECTF-ERROR--` block — paste only the `error[...]` line and the `-->` line under it.
